description: This file defines the AWS CodeConnections client class, which provides methods to interact with the AWS CodeConnections service, including creating, deleting, retrieving, and updating connections, hosts, repository links, sync configurations, etc. It extends the generic AWS client.

classes.name: CodeConnectionsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS CodeConnections service, providing various methods to manage connections, hosts, repositories, and sync configurations.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a new AWS CodeConnections connection.

methods.name: createHost
methods.description: Creates a new host for AWS CodeConnections.

methods.name: createRepositoryLink
methods.description: Creates a repository link in AWS CodeConnections.

methods.name: createSyncConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a sync configuration for AWS CodeConnections.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific connection.

methods.name: getRepositoryLink
methods.description: Retrieves details about a repository link.

methods.name: getRepositorySyncStatus
methods.description: Checks the sync status of a repository.

methods.name: getResourceSyncStatus
methods.description: Gets the sync status of a resource.

methods.name: getSyncBlockerSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of sync blockers.
